discovery.source_kind: Exact manufacturer product page, SKU, current list price and product configuration
discovery.result: Official ABC Tech Philippines page identifies X10 Study Buddy Tablet, manufacturer SKU X10-CB-10I-464,  4GB RAM / 64GB storage, Android 12, a 10.1-inch TN/IPS display advertised at 1200×2000, 13MP rear and 8MP front cameras, 6000mAh battery, expandable storage (up to 256GB), GPS, Wi-Fi and Bluetooth. It lists PHP 8,499, offers Add to Cart and Philippine shipping estimates; live stock/checkout was not verified.

discovery.source_kind: Official brand catalog and cross-check of model naming, display, RAM/storage and battery
discovery.result: The official home page lists separate X10 and X10 Plus models; X10 is shown as 10.1-inch / 4+64GB / 6,000mAh and X10 Plus as 10.4-inch / 8+128GB / 7,000mAh. The home page lists current store prices PHP 8,499 and PHP 11,499, respectively.

discovery.source_kind: Manufacturer-hosted Philippine release date and launch configuration
discovery.result: The manufacturer-hosted story is dated 2023-07-28 and says ABC Tech released the X8, X10 and X10 Plus on July 28. It identifies the X10 as a 10.1-inch / 64GB tablet and the X10 Plus as a 10.4-inch / 128GB upgrade. It says the higher models have an 8MP front and 13MP rear camera. It does not state an international launch date or a launch price.

discovery.source_kind: Philippine launch-price and independent technical cross-check
discovery.result: Published 2023-08-15. Reports launch-period prices of PHP 8,499 (X10) and PHP 11,499 (X10 Plus). Its X10 prose and table disagree on front camera (8MP vs 5MP); the table reports 1280×800 while the manufacturer says 1200×2000. Its X10 Plus prose and table disagree on chipset (T616 vs SC9863), GPU (Mali-G52 MP2 vs PowerVR GE8320), front camera (8MP vs 5MP), display size (10.4 vs 10-inch), and display pixels are 2000×1200. These internal disagreements are retained in review notes rather than silently collapsed.

discovery.source_kind: Independent Philippine launch coverage and configuration cross-check
discovery.result: Published 2023-08-01. Reports X10 as 10.1-inch, 4GB/64GB, Android 12, 6,000mAh, 13MP rear / 8MP front, PHP 8,499; reports X10 Plus as 10.4-inch, 8GB/128GB, Android 12, 7,000mAh, 13MP rear / 8MP front, PHP 11,499. It does not provide exact product SKUs or display pixel resolution.

discovery.source_kind: Independent Philippine review and X10/X10 Plus model distinction
discovery.result: Published 2023-08-31. Reviews the ABC Tech X10 at PHP 8,499 and identifies its 10.1-inch / 64GB configuration; distinguishes the X10 Plus as the larger 10.4-inch / 128GB model. The review does not verify the exact manufacturer SKU.

discovery.source_kind: Exact tablet compatibility for the optional docking-keyboard accessory
discovery.result: Official Key Touch Docking Keyboard page (SKU DK-BK-X10) explicitly offers selectable ABC TECH X10 and X10 Plus sizes. This verifies a compatible keyboard accessory, not that a keyboard is included with every tablet sale.
